observations: A black manual sewing machine with ornate gold detailing is shown on a granite-topped table with a metal stand.
The brand name 'YAH-HONG' is visible in gold lettering on the front of the machine in photo 0 and photo 1.
A white electric motor is attached to the side of the machine, connected by a belt to the handwheel.
A white foot pedal is also present, connected by a black cord.
The machine appears aged, with some paint chipping and wear visible on the body and stand.
The stand has a metal footrest with a circular design and shows signs of rust and wear.
The granite tabletop is speckled and appears clean, but the metal frame of the stand is corroded in places.
No visible damage to the needle or presser foot area in the photos.
The handwheel is intact and appears functional, though not spun in the photos.

claims.claim: Complete used manual sewing machine available with electric motor.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the machine with an attached electric motor and foot pedal. The machine is on a stand, and all components appear present.

risks.risk: The electric motor may not work or may be incompatible with Nigerian voltage (220V, 50Hz).
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running when the foot pedal is pressed, or a close-up of the motor's label showing voltage and frequency ratings.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal mechanical damage or wear that prevents smooth operation.
risks.proof: A video showing the handwheel turning smoothly and the needle moving up and down without resistance.

risks.risk: The stand may be unstable or structurally compromised due to rust and wear.
risks.proof: A close-up of the metal joints and legs of the stand, showing any cracks, bends, or loose connections.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential accessories such as bobbins, needles, or a tension adjustment tool.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out on the table.

proof_requests: Video of the electric motor running when the foot pedal is pressed.
Video of the handwheel turning smoothly and the needle moving up and down.
Close-up of the motor's label showing voltage and frequency ratings.
Photo of all included accessories (bobbins, needles, tools, etc.).
Close-up of the stand's joints and legs to check for rust or structural damage.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a YAH-HONG manual sewing machine with an electric motor, and the seller's claim is supported by the photos. However, critical functional and structural risks remain unverified, including motor operation, mechanical smoothness, stand stability, and completeness of accessories. These must be proven before pricing can be determined.
